answers.text: "div BEARISH/1 is a caution, not a veto." My C25 test: a high on lighter volume plus a bearish oscillator read is distribution. day_vol 0.85 is under 1.40; W swing LH/LL and D 3.3% under 20-day high show no breakout. Held.

"Inside the buy zone at pct_from_pivot 1.04 is a breakout read." Agreed, and that is my buy: C17 allows up to 5% past the pivot. Distance from ma20 is value-line language, not my test. W and D HH/HL, day_vol 3.1. Held.

"rs and group state are not my test." They are mine: C9 and C10 make leadership a gate. rs_leadership IN-LINE with downday 0.21 is not LEADER, so the L test fails whatever the retest shows. W/D/H1 HH/HL noted. Held.

"LAGGARD contradicts rs_rank_pct 99.33, ret_63d 73.97." rs_rank_pct is not on my menu. My L test reads rs_leadership: LAGGARD, downday -2.37, falls with the tape. Entry 32.41 vs ma200 17.21 is past my C24 70 pct line. Held.

"LAGGARD downday -2.37 is not my test." It is mine (C9, C10). Grid: W HH/HL, D LH but HL 4.3% above swing high, H1 37% of range; none repairs LAGGARD. entry 32.41 vs ma200 17.21 is my climax line (C24), not entry location. Held.

"Weekly above EMA9 with 9>21 is not a broken weekly." Agreed, I never called it broken. My C16 test fails: day_vol 1.03 is under 1.40 and lens coil warn means no tight base (C12). W swing HH but LL, 4.0% under 20-wk high. Held.

"coil warn is not my test." It is mine: R3, no tight base means no pivot. day_vol 1.03 is under 1.40 (C16). D HH/HL 1.2% under high and H1 HH/HL are noted but a drift near highs without volume is not a breakout. Held.

"ma200, coil and the setup-grade flag are not my test." ma200 and coil are: R7 and R3. entry 21.95 vs ma200 12.47 is 76 pct over, past my 70 pct climax line (C24). Grid HH/HL on W, D, H1 and day_vol 1.82 noted. Held.

"sma_dist 23.76 and entry vs ma200 12.47 are extension, not a fault." For C24 it is the fault: a name 70 pct or more over its 200-day is sold into, not bought. D 0.1% under swing high, day_vol 1.82 noted. Held.
